FormDataCollection.Delete

FormDataCollection

Delete

Available since version 8.2.

Syntax variant: By index

Syntax:

Delete(<Index>)

Parameters:

<Index> (required)

Type: Number.
Index of an item in a collection.

Syntax variant: By item

Syntax:

Delete(<Item>)

Parameters:

<Item> (required)

Type: FormDataCollectionItem.
Deleted item.

Description:

Deletes an item from the collection.

Availability:

Thin client, web-client, mobile client, server, thick client, mobile application (client), mobile application (server), mobile standalone server.

Available since:

Available since version 8.2.
